notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Sprawl attached to a basic Forest.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
"White" chosen with Utopia Sprawl.
description:
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Utopia Sprawl triggers, adding {W}.
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Angel, untapping the Forest.
Repeat.
